subject: akane-gwen
q: CLOSED — and one of the four was never a wedding.
detail: Jade and Pandora were married in Arc 5 when the app opened, officially in Arc 6. Lucia and Siren, Arc 12. Sage and Zephi, Arc 12. And Akane and Gwen married common-law by Oath ceremony in Arc 10 — the Archive first read it as a plain marriage, then over-corrected to no marriage at all, and the truth is that Gwen's paladin oath forbids the legal kind and the Oath is the form the vow took.
